component.name: Apache Commons Imaging
component.description: Pure-Java image library. Generally, Apache Commons libraries do not support possibly-malicious input unless otherwise specified. For Commons Imaging, processing untrusted image material is supported to some extent: it should never lead to code execution, but the component currently does not guarantee the absence of denial-of-service conditions.

externalReferences.comment: Source security page; this file is a structured translation of it.

threats.name: Code execution from untrusted image material
threats.description: Processing untrusted image material is supported to some extent: it should never lead to code execution. A code path where a crafted image leads to code execution is a security issue in the component.

threats.name: Denial of service from untrusted image material
threats.description: The component currently does not guarantee the absence of DoS conditions; applications processing untrusted images should be made resilient against memory, CPU and stack exhaustion problems. Specific cases where certain inputs lead to disproportionate resource usage are welcomed as regular (non-security) issues or contributions; IMAGING-379 tracks general protections against such problems.

controls.name: Application resilience against resource exhaustion
controls.description: Applications processing untrusted images should be made resilient against memory, CPU and stack exhaustion problems, since the component does not currently guarantee the absence of DoS conditions.
